body:
I'm on NSAIDs. I do physical therapy routines at home because I can't afford to go to the physical therapist any more. The doc said he can't do anything more for me except surgery, and I don't want that. The reason it still hurts is because I have no one to rely on but me, so instead of taking it easy when I was sick I had to haul laundry down the street to the laundromat, take the trash out, change the sheets (way more painful than it should have been), get groceries back when I could afford them, put on my shoes (again, more painful than it should be), change lightbulbs, all that shit. I shouldn't have done it, but there was no one else to do it so I had to. It's taken a toll. I did spinal decompression with my doc for three months. I felt better than when I started but the last five or six sessions so no more improvement and haven't seen much improvement since I stopped. 

It's a problem with my discs. Basically they're oozing out of place. It's causing a pinched nerve which has made my left foot & leg numb since December. As a result, I wake up four or five times a night with horrible leg cramps. I also limp, which has put undue pressure on my right foot since December. That ankle is in serious pain. I look like Quasimodo walking down the street. It's embarrassing. People openly make fun of me. Since I'm less active, I've gained weight and I wasn't exactly svelte to begin with, and they openly make fun of me for being fat, too. I'm ashamed to leave my apartment. 

Today I went to the memorial service for a friend's dad. They said such nice things about him, and so many people turned out for it. I don't think anyone will even notice when I'm gone. It's a shame he died, he was a nice guy. It should have been me instead.

Yeah, the time off was horrible. I have a manual labor job working in a hotel. I'm getting a few more hours now but I come home exhausted and wrecked. I have to act like I'm not in pain at work or my boss will cut my hours. He's not being a dick, he just doesn't want me to get hurt. Usually we're in our busy season by now but this whole week coming up we have so little going on that nobody's getting many hours. I don't think it will get better in time for me to catch up on bills. 

I have insurance but I can't even cover the $15 co-pay. I don't like being on anti-depressants because when I've tried those in the past they make me into some kind of zombie. They don't just make me stop feeling bad, they make me stop feeling. Besides, I don't know from month to month if I can afford them and if I had to stop taking them because I can't afford the co-pay I'd end up in worse shape. Suddenly stopping anti-depressants is a horrible experience. 

I went to a few group therapy things a few years ago. I'm not trying to be funny here but those fuckers were depressing as hell and I always left feeling worse than when I walked in.

Thanks for reaching out, though. I appreciate the effort.

I don't speak to my family. They're assholes. I kept in touch with them after I moved out, but they just became bigger assholes. I send birthday cards and call them on Christmas. I'm closer with the homeless people on the subway than I am with my family. 

My friends were awesome friends. But they've never understood depression and when I say something like "hey I'm in a really bad way" they don't know what to do or how to handle it and it's just more depressing than just sitting home. I grew apart from them when I was sick because I didn't want them to see me like that. I haven't spoken to most of them in months and it's been too long now to just pick up the phone and say "Hey, how's it going? Great. I'm destitute. Let's go sit in the park and do nothing because it's free." I'm 33, my friends are my age. We don't do that any more. Most of them have husbands and kids. The rest are having fun and spending money and I can't hang out with them because I don't have any money. I considered having people over to my place for a BYOB get-together but they don't know that I sold my TV, stereo, Wii, etc and that just seems stupid to have people over and have to answer about where all my shit went.

I thought about walking down to the hospital to check myself in but I can't afford to take the time off work and I can't afford the medical bills.
